_comment: Opt-in review, exact-ID gate: glm-5.3-flash-extended shares a prefix with a known row but is unknown, so no facts and no go.review source; catalog availability source still present. REDs before impl: startup rejects metadata_source.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
metadata_source = "opencode-go-v1"

[catalog.model_providers]
"glm-5.3-flash-extended" = "chatup"

paths.data.1.metadata.router.sources.routing.v: configured transport and adapter paths only

name: m4_catalog_capability_unknown_prefix_empty
